label: PF Backlog 465
title: Docs: BRANCHING-GIT-WORKFLOW.md (branch/worktree/merge/push across PF, products, intake, worker)
body:
Source: user request (2026-10-07) - document the actual git branching/workflow end to end.

Add `docs/BRANCHING-GIT-WORKFLOW.md`: branch/worktree/merge/push flow for (A) generated products (PF pipeline),
(B) PF's own backlog via intake -> PF pipeline, (C) PF's own backlog via the WORKER (claim -> worktree ->
runtime -> complete -> delivery lane), (D) an agent/session DoD change; the git primitive layer (core/vcs.py),
worktrees (folders, IS-PF-0036), fetch/base_ref, rebase/merge/conflict handling, the pr_gate/merge_gate, and the
delivery landing (gh pr merge / integrate-worktree push-ref). Purpose: one accurate reference so the team
understands what is called and where.
